title: A data-based image representation for continuous-time LTI systems
summary: We derive a numerically stable method to compute an image representation of an unknown linear system only from data, leveraging a continuous-time version of Willems et al.'s fundamental lemma. To this end, we use derivatives approximated by algebraic differentiators. Our novel image representation avoids solving differential-algebraic equations and significantly reduces computational complexity by eliminating redundant degrees of freedom corresponding to the number of unknown quantities to be identified.
